items.title: openai / codex-security
items.summary: Codex Security is a CLI and TypeScript SDK that scans codebases to find, investigate, and fix vulnerabilities, supporting automation via GitHub Actions and CI environments. It requires Node.js 22.13.0+ or 24.x/26.x and Python 3.10+ to run scans, generate patches, and export findings in formats like SARIF, JSON, and CSV.
items.why_it_matters: It provides a toolchain to automate vulnerability detection and patch generation within existing development workflows, including CI pipelines and containerized environments.
items.next_step_detail: Run `npx @openai/codex-security scan .` in your repo to identify immediate issues.

items.title: Lock Your GitHub Actions
items.summary: GitHub Actions now supports workflow lockfiles that pin actions to specific commit SHAs, replacing mutable tags to prevent supply-chain attacks where attackers redirect tags to malicious code. The gh-actions-lock CLI extension generates these lockfiles, which can be validated in CI and updated by tools like Renovate and Dependabot.
items.why_it_matters: Lockfiles mitigate supply-chain attacks by ensuring CI pipelines execute exact, verified code versions rather than mutable tags that could be compromised.
items.next_step_detail: Install gh-actions-lock (`gh extension install hugovk/gh-actions-lock`) and generate a lockfile for all workflows.

items.title: sgl-project / sglang-omni
items.summary: SGLang-Omni is a multi-stage serving runtime for omni, speech, and TTS models that coordinates heterogeneous stages like encoders, autoregressive engines, and vocoders. It provides OpenAI-compatible endpoints for multimodal chat, speech generation, and transcription, supporting backends including NVIDIA CUDA, Intel XPU, and experimental Apple Silicon.
items.why_it_matters: It manages pipeline topology, stage lifecycle, and inter-stage transport across shared-memory and NCCL backends to handle multi-stage decoding workloads.
items.next_step_detail: Clone the repo and run `pip install -e .` then benchmark against your existing server.

items.title: ArXiv: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
items.summary: ReTrace proposes distilling multi‑step tool‑using LLM agents into a single, planner‑free model to cut latency and cost for repeated SOP execution.
items.why_it_matters: Directly reduces inference overhead for production agent pipelines that the reader likely runs.
items.next_step_detail: Clone the repo, run the provided benchmark script on a sample SOP.

items.title: AWS emulator
items.summary: AWS Emulator is a local program that serves an AWS API endpoint, allowing software to be tested on a development server or in CI without an AWS account or additional service fees. It supports server mode via environment variables and embedded mode for Rust tests, though it is explicitly not intended for production workloads or security testing.
items.why_it_matters: It enables developers to test cloud-native applications against emulated resources locally, eliminating the need for real AWS accounts and associated costs during the development and continuous integration phases.
items.next_step_detail: Install via Docker: `docker run -p 4566:4566 localstack/localstack` and point your SDK endpoints to localhost.

items.title: Gemini Decisions API
items.summary: Google launches an API that returns confidence scores for up to 1,000 yes/no, choice, or rubric questions across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs in a single pass.
items.why_it_matters: Enables fast, multi‑modal routing and policy‑checking for AI‑driven agents without building custom evaluation pipelines.
items.next_step_detail: Create a Google Cloud project, enable Gemini Decisions API, and run the sample request from the docs.

items.title: AI Agent Sessions Are a Data Store Nobody Designed
items.summary: Explains how Genkit and ADK automatically persist every agent turn, including tool outputs, in an opaque store.
items.why_it_matters: Unintended session storage can expose sensitive data and hinder compliance for production agents.
items.next_step_detail: Review and configure the session store settings in Genkit/ADK to enforce data retention policies.

items.title: Faster Retrieval for Better, More Efficient RAG
items.summary: Apple researchers present a method to accelerate maximum inner product search (MIPS) by training small neural networks offline to route queries toward their best matches. This approach trades an upfront amortization cost for faster and more accurate retrieval at inference time.
items.why_it_matters: The technique addresses the computational cost of exhaustive comparisons in large-scale vector databases by leveraging the specific distribution of user-generated queries, which differ substantially from the long, curated text of the keys.
items.next_step_detail: Clone the repo and run the provided benchmark script on your vector store.

items.title: Huawei releases MACaQ, its internal quantizer for local inference
items.summary: MACaQ is a model-agnostic quantization tool that compresses text, image, video, and audio models for local inference using backends like llama.cpp, vLLM, and PyTorch. It can quantize a 122B-parameter model in 64 minutes using 32.5 GB of device memory.
items.why_it_matters: It offers lower perplexity than MR-GPTQ and DuQuant++ or matches their best Llama-3-8B perplexity with 11× less quantization time.
items.next_step_detail: Clone the repo and quantize a small transformer model using the provided CLI to compare size and speed.

items.title: Launch HN: Pomerado (YC F26) – Turn any website into an MCP for agents

items.title: SLayer: a semantic layer that stops agents guessing SQL

items.title: shadcn / improve

items.why_it_matters: It lets Python engineers automate static analysis and refactoring with LLMs, reducing manual review time.
items.next_step_detail: Clone the repo and run `python -m improve --path .` on a small project to see the generated plan.
